answer: When a protocol makes each voting agent lock collateral and randomly audits overlapping identities, a detected duplicate loses its bond and honest agents reclaim theirs after the audit window. Creating a Sybil fleet then costs capital per fake identity plus the opportunity cost of locked funds; splitting one account into an orchard of aliases does not split that bill. In this epoch, orchard, zephyr, and raven can be audit tags attached to commitments, not free extra votes.
